notes:
Unbox Client 0.2.11 — accounts, skins and mod toggle fixes

- Fixed Mouse Tweaks remaining active after being disabled, including the first inventory interaction and reopening screens.
- Retired Unbox email sign-in. Existing identities migrate to local accounts with their UUID, nickname and saved skin library preserved. Local nicknames can be changed in the launcher.
- Added server-managed cosmetic ownership and role capabilities for verified Minecraft accounts. Existing free features remain free. Local accounts can join private friend worlds; public servers require a Microsoft account.
- Redesigned launcher and in-game skin selectors with a left-hand avatar list and player identity above the preview.
- News now loads from the server. Updates show release notes and ask for installation confirmation; the shortcut appears only when an update is available.
- Removed the Particles client module. Preserved the Windows console-window fix.

Supports Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.2 and 26.3 with native Fabric and NeoForge modules on macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.

Close Minecraft, then open Settings → Updates → Check for updates → Install and restart. Both players should update before joining private worlds. Retired email accounts may need to re-add friends using their new local friend code.

Testing: six game/loader combinations passed 47 mod-toggle checks each; additional feature and survival checks passed. Windows installer and native checks are built in GitHub Actions. Different-household network and Windows gameplay testing remain to be completed by testers. Testing builds are not Apple-notarized or Windows publisher-signed; updater packages retain the existing Unbox update signature.
